Lens era.uncoated pre-war glass: shot through uncoated pre-war glass, low contrast with a warm straw cast, veiling glare lifting the black, edges soft and unresolved
Lens era.single-coated sixties glass: shot through single-coated glass, a warm amber cast on every reflection, moderate veiling, edges that stay soft wide open
Lens era.modern multicoated glass: shot through modern multicoated glass, neutral and high in contrast, the black staying black, the shape small and cleanly defined
Lens era.anamorphic front element: shot through an anamorphic front element, a cool blue-green cast on every reflection, stretched horizontally, gentle halation
Lens era.long telephoto: shot on a long telephoto, the shape large and flattened against the frame, its edges compressed and low in contrast

Capture medium.colour negative: recorded on tungsten-balanced colour negative, fine grain, red halation blooming around the brightest area, highlights rolling off gently instead of clipping
Capture medium.colour reversal stock: recorded on colour reversal stock, high in contrast and heavily saturated, highlights clipping hard with almost no roll-off, the black very deep
Capture medium.black and white negative: recorded on black and white negative, neutral silver tones with no colour anywhere, pronounced grain, a soft glow around the brightest area
Capture medium.65mm negative: recorded on 65mm negative, extremely fine grain and an enormous tonal range, the whole shape smooth and cleanly resolved
Capture medium.digital sensor: recorded on a digital sensor, clean and noise-free in the shadows, the core clipping abruptly to white with a faint magenta edge where it saturates
Capture medium.early video tube: recorded on an early video tube, soft and slightly smeared, the brightest area blooming and trailing a little to one side

Lens condition.dusty scratched glass: with a dusty scratched front element, fine bright specks and hairline scratches catching the light across the shape
Lens condition.greasy fingerprint: with a greasy fingerprint smeared across the front element, the shape softened and drawn out in streaks where the grease spreads it
Lens condition.rain on the glass: with rain beading on the front element, small round droplets scattered over the shape, each carrying a tiny bright copy of the light
Lens condition.breath fog: with breath fogging the front element, a milky bloom spreading unevenly across the shape and thinning toward one edge
Lens condition.separated cement: through an old lens whose cemented elements have begun to separate, a yellowed irregular edge and a faint second image offset from the first

Atmosphere.atmospheric haze: through heavy atmospheric haze on set, the shape diffused and enlarged, its edges dissolving into a broad soft bloom
Atmosphere.thick fog: in thick fog, the shape swollen into a large diffuse ball with almost no defined edge, low in contrast throughout
Atmosphere.dust in the air: with dust hanging in the air, the shape broken up by drifting specks that each catch a point of light
Atmosphere.underwater: photographed underwater, a strong blue-green cast, the shape softened and rippling, fine suspended particles catching the light

Light source.tungsten lamp: lit by a tungsten lamp at 3200K, a deep warm orange cast throughout with the core burning out to white
Light source.daylight arc lamp: lit by a daylight-balanced arc lamp at 5600K, crisp and faintly cool, the core a clean neutral white
Light source.sodium street lamp: lit by a low-pressure sodium street lamp, almost monochromatic amber-orange with no other colour present anywhere
Light source.mercury vapour lamp: lit by a mercury vapour lamp, a cold green-cyan cast with a faint violet edge, slightly harsh
Light source.candle flame: lit by candle flame, very warm and deep orange, dim and unsteady, the shape small and soft
Light source.cold LED headlight: lit by a cold white LED headlight, hard-edged and faintly blue, the core clipping sharply at a crisp boundary
Light source.firelight: lit by open firelight, warm orange shading to red at the edges, uneven in brightness as though flickering

Filtration.black diffusion filter: shot through a black diffusion filter, the highlight blooming into a soft halo while the blacks stay dense and un-lifted
Filtration.heavy diffusion: shot through heavy diffusion, the whole shape softened and its edges bled outward into a milky glow
Filtration.two-line streak filter: shot through a two-line streak filter, a long horizontal blue streak drawn out through the brightest area
Filtration.six-point star filter: shot through a six-point star filter, six even spikes radiating from the brightest area
Filtration.warming filter: shot through a warming filter, the whole shape pushed toward amber with the cool tones removed
